claim_scope: Appendix diagnostic: index-aligned synthetic application of empirical held-out normal-force regression residuals; no validated sensor or sim-to-real claim
limitations: Source normal labels approximately0.073–1.888N; simulator budget8N is outside observed load range.
Single-sensor trajectory errors mapped to separately drawn finger blocks; cross-finger error correlation is not measured.
One source index per20Hz simulator observation is imposed; no real acquisition frequency/latency is assumed.
Regression residual includes estimator, target measurement, preprocessing and alignment error, not identified electronics noise.
Only normal observations are perturbed; shear, images, proprioception and ground-truth outcomes remain unchanged.
Reuses existing held-out public predictions as perturbation library; not a new public-dataset model evaluation.
Long-trajectory-conditioned subset and fixed additive error transport; not physical sensor validation or sim-to-real.
